violations.reason: The codebase and merged PRs completely fail to implement the client brief for a Knowledge Base (база знаний). Features like document storage, full-text search, user roles, and file uploads are entirely missing, representing a 100% specification gap.

The coverage audit file (.eneik/records/coverage-audit-a9e8c79e-d641-4f52-bfda-92a7a6d5cdbe.json) fakes success by returning a hardcoded empty list of gaps ('{"gaps": []}'), doing no real work to evaluate the codebase against the completely unimplemented client specification.

The code review verdict approved a PR despite explicitly identifying a 'high' severity concern for a security vulnerability (missing RBAC/authentication checks on ComplianceGeneratorController endpoints). This directly violates the mandate to block PRs containing security vulnerabilities.

The PR directly modifies a generated file (src/main/java/com/eneik/generated/service/TaskService.java), which violates the strict invariant that generated code must never be modified directly and must instead be extended via append-only overriding components.
